subunit.text: Homodimer (PubMed:29440439, PubMed:29681455). Component of complex I, at least composed of TNFRSF1A, RIPK1, TRADD, BIRC2/c-IAP1 and BIRC3/c-IAP2 (PubMed:12887920, PubMed:41922760). Component of complex IIa at least composed of RIPK1, FADD and CASP8 (PubMed:12887920, PubMed:18485876). Component of complex IIb, also named necrosome, at least composed of RIPK1, RIPK3 and MLKL (PubMed:21737330, PubMed:41436733). Within complex IIb, an approximative 3:1 ratio of RIPK3 to RIPK1 is required for necroptosis (PubMed:41436733). Interacts (via RIP homotypic interaction motif) with RIPK3 (via RIP homotypic interaction motif); this interaction induces RIPK1 phosphorylation and formation of a RIPK1-RIPK3 amyloid signaling complex that induced necroptosis (PubMed:10358032, PubMed:11734559, PubMed:19524512, PubMed:22817896, PubMed:29681455, PubMed:29883609, PubMed:41436733). Upon TNF-induced necrosis, the RIPK1-RIPK3 dimer further interacts with PGAM5 and MLKL; the formation of this complex leads to PGAM5 phosphorylation and increase in PGAM5 phosphatase activity (PubMed:22265414). Component of the AIM2 PANoptosome complex, a multiprotein complex that drives inflammatory cell death (PANoptosis) (By similarity). Is recruited by TRADD to TNFRSF1A in a TNF-dependent process (PubMed:24130170). Interacts (via the death domain) with TRADD (via the death domain) (PubMed:8612133). Binds RNF216, EGFR, IKBKG, TRAF1, TRAF2 and TRAF3 (PubMed:10356400, PubMed:11116146, PubMed:11854271, PubMed:8612133, PubMed:9927690). Interacts (via death domain) with CRADD (via death domain); the interaction is direct (PubMed:9044836). Interacts with BNLF1 (PubMed:10409763). Interacts with SQSTM1 upon TNF stimulation (PubMed:10356400). May interact with MAVS (PubMed:16127453). Interacts with ZFAND5 (PubMed:14754897). Interacts with ZBP1 (By similarity). Interacts with XIAP/BIRC4 (PubMed:21931591). Interacts with ARHGEF2 (PubMed:21887730). Interacts with TICAM1 and this interaction is enhanced in the presence of WDFY1 (PubMed:25736436). Interacts with TAX1BP1 (PubMed:17703191). Interacts with GRB2 (PubMed:35831301). Interacts with DDX24; this interaction disrupts RLR signaling activation of IFN-dependent transcription factor IRF7 (PubMed:24204270). Interacts with MAP3K7, CFLAR and NEMO (By similarity). Interacts with TAX1BP1; promoting recruitment of TNKS/PARP5A and RNF146 to RIPK1 during necroptosis (By similarity)
(Microbial infection) Interacts with mumps virus protein SH; this interaction inhibits downstream NF-kappa-B pathway activation
(Microbial infection) Interacts with Murid herpesvirus 1 protein RIR1

(Microbial infection) Interacts (via RIP homotypic interaction motif) with herpes simplex virus 1/HHV-1 protein RIR1/ICP6 (via RIP homotypic interaction motif); this interaction prevents necroptosis activation

(Microbial infection) Interacts (via RIP homotypic interaction motif) with herpes simplex virus 2/HHV-2 protein RIR1/ICP10 (via RIP homotypic interaction motif); this interaction prevents necroptosis activation
